name: Paraty
blurb: Mentions of Paraty have fallen well below their six-month baseline. Recent posts skew towards crowding and rising prices.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season
Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
